name: Pão-Pão, Beijo-Beijo
description: To defend the humble Soró Sereno in a traffic accident, the mysterious Ciro Cerqueira, a bus driver, ends up getting involved with the traditional italian family of Mamma Vittoria Cantarelli, owner of a chain of canteens in which he starts to work as an executive, and is torn between the love of the matriarch's granddaughters, the responsible Luísa and the seductive Bruna, a woman who spares no effort to get what she wants.

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: Guido dismisses the employees and says goodbye to the restaurant. Bruna drinks too much, runs over Soró, and Ciro takes the blame. Ciro and Soró go to Bruna's house. Bruna and Julio get engaged.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: Julio feels insecure about his relationship with Bruna. Ciro and Soró go to meet Luísa and are humiliated by Bruna. Guido asks his family to keep his bankruptcy a secret.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: Luisa gets jobs for Ciro and Soro. Guido and his family move. Nina and Daniel think about each other. Ciro invites Soro to live with him. Bruna finds out about Ciro's new job.

videos.title: Chapter 4
videos.overview: Bruna and Julio are bothered by Ciro's presence at home and at the company. Nina goes to the pool with Franco and looks for Daniel. Ciro observes a young woman from afar.

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: Bruna warns Julio about Ciro's work and mentions Mamma Vitória's fondness for him. Daniel thinks about Nina and goes to her house. Soró tells Ciro that Bruna asked about him.

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: Daniel and Nina kiss. Guido arrives at Mamma Vitória's house, who suspects she's lying. Ciro is late for work and Bruna gives him a ride.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: Bruna takes Ciro to a deserted beach, they argue, and she leaves him there. Luisa almost fires Ciro. Nina and Daniel meet again.

videos.title: Chapter 8
videos.overview: Franco advises Nina to tell the truth. Ciro calls Luísa and invites her out. Bruna gets jealous of her sister. Guido walks around the house sadly, and Mamma Vitória pressures him.

videos.title: Chapter 9
videos.overview: Guido tells Mamma Vitória about the bankruptcy, and she decides to hold a meeting. Gema worries about her daughters' interest in Ciro. Nina decides not to tell Daniel the truth.

videos.title: Chapter 10
videos.overview: Mamma Vitória defends Ciro and goes against Bruna. Mamma Vitória announces that Guido will become a partner in the canteens. Bruna and Luísa argue because of Ciro.

videos.title: Chapter 11
videos.overview: Ciro and Soró lose their jobs after being involved in an accident with Bruna, heiress to a chain of Italian restaurants. Bruna's family hires them both to compensate for the financial loss.

videos.title: Chapter 12
videos.overview: Julio and Bruna argue, and she confesses that she went to Ciro's house. Geninho and Soró build a toy. Guido prepares for his first day of work.

videos.title: Chapter 13
videos.overview: Bruna explains to Julio why she went to Ciro's house. Duda discovers that Daniel is the caretaker's son and remains interested in him. Gigio returns home.

videos.title: Chapter 14 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Luísa and Bruna talk and make peace. Ciro takes work home and thinks about how to talk to Mamma Vitória. Daniel and Nina continue to hide the truth from each other.

videos.title: Chapter 14 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Bruna and Julio announce they will set a wedding date. Luisa and Bruna exchange barbs again. Altino says he doesn't believe Bruna will marry his son.

videos.title: Chapter 15
videos.overview: Ciro congratulates Bruna on her engagement and gives her a kiss.

videos.title: Chapter 16
videos.overview: Ciro asks to speak to Alice.

videos.title: Chapter 17
videos.overview: Nina asks Daniel if he knows the janitor's son.

videos.title: Chapter 18
videos.overview: Júlio discovers that Bruna and Luísa are interested in Ciro.

videos.title: Chapter 19
videos.overview: Bruna tells Júlio that Ciro was promoted.

videos.title: Chapter 20
videos.overview: Duda questions Franco about the janitor's son.

videos.title: Chapter 21
videos.overview: Ciro demands that Júlio pay attention to him.

videos.title: Chapter 22 (Part 1)
videos.overview: Bruna warns Luísa not to have dinner with Ciro.

videos.title: Chapter 22 (Part 2)
videos.overview: Soró goes to the police station and receives an alert about Ciro.

videos.title: Chapter 23
videos.overview: Ciro drinks too much and calls Luísa "Bruna." Julio decides to travel to São Paulo. Geninho discovers Soró's greatest wish and tells Mamma Vitória.

videos.title: Chapter 24
videos.overview: Luísa restricts her relationship with Ciro. Altino and Nizi worry about Julio. Mamma Vitória fulfills Soró's wish. Bruna gets information about Ciro.

videos.title: Chapter 25
videos.overview: Bruna manages to get information about Ciro's past at the mansion. Ciro kisses Bruna. Duda looks for information about Daniel. Julio talks to his parents and reassures them.

videos.title: Chapter 26
videos.overview: Mamma is convinced not to report Julio. Duda is hurt after Daniel's refusal. Bruna warns Luísa about Ciro. Mendes introduces himself to Julio and surprises him.

videos.title: Chapter 27
videos.overview: Julio is perplexed when he meets Dr. Mendes. Luisa concludes that Julio's parents have senility. Bruna warns Mamma Vitória about Ciro.

videos.title: Chapter 28
videos.overview: Mamma Vitória asks Ciro to stay away from Bruna. Nizi and Altino are hurt by Julio's ingratitude. Soró tells Ciro about his conversation with the police chief.

videos.title: Chapter 29
videos.overview: Mamma Vitória attacks Bruna after insinuations from her granddaughter. The family regrets what happened and crucifies Bruna. Soró discovers that the family is coming to Rio de Janeiro.

videos.title: Chapter 30
videos.overview: Bruna convinces the family that Mamma Vitória interferes in everyone's lives. Mamma Vitória tries to rush Bruna's wedding. Gaspar encourages his son to make his dream come true.

videos.title: Chapter 31
videos.overview: Mamma Vitória lets Bruna participate in the lunch, gives her the jewelry again and invites Julio to return to work in the canteens. Daniel and Gaspar try to get a loan.

videos.title: Chapter 32
videos.overview: Bruna tells Julio that she is confused and that she can't marry him like that. Julio argues with his father because of Bruna. Soró's family arrives in Rio de Janeiro.

videos.title: Chapter 33
videos.overview: Soró gets emotional upon reuniting with his family. Ciro takes Soró and his family home and gives them shelter. Daniel goes to Nina's house and asks to speak with her mother.

videos.title: Chapter 34
videos.overview: Joana talks to Daniel, and Nina finds out. Daniel leaves, furious. Ciro finds Julio in his office, and they argue. Altino and Julio make peace.

videos.title: Chapter 35
videos.overview: Joana tells Nina that she didn't tell Daniel the truth, but Nina is still worried. Soró's family goes to church and gets lost. Ciro invites Luísa to dinner.

videos.title: Chapter 36
videos.overview: Soró is desperate when his family disappears and asks Ciro for help. Nina thinks Daniel has found out everything and asks Franco for help. Ciro and Soró are surprised when they arrive home.

videos.title: Chapter 37
videos.overview: Ciro and Soró reunite with their family. A spark ignites between Franco and Duda. Luísa and Ciro go out to dinner, and Bruna gets jealous. Bruna makes a mysterious phone call.

videos.title: Chapter 38
videos.overview: Mauro will meet Bruna at the same restaurant where Ciro and Luísa are. Franco asks Duda about her love life. Daniel picks up Nina from her course.

videos.title: Chapter 39
videos.overview: Daniel and Nina talk and clarify the reason for their estrangement. Ciro tries to find Mariana a job at the cafeteria. Bruna offers her car for Ciro to buy.

videos.title: Chapter 40
videos.overview: Ciro advises Bruna to resume her engagement with Júlio.

videos.title: Chapter 41
videos.overview: Ciro kicks Julio out of the car. Julio arrives home drunk and argues with his parents. Ciro takes Mariana shopping for clothes and then takes her to the office. Franco is jealous of Duda.

videos.title: Chapter 42
videos.overview: Ciro manages to get Mariana a job at the office. Gigio secretly prepares the cafeteria report. Duda asks Milica for help to talk to Daniel.

videos.title: Chapter 43
videos.overview: Daniel tells Duda that he has a girlfriend and that they can't study together. Bruna asks Julio not to hire Soró's sister as a secretary in the cafeterias.

videos.title: Chapter 44
videos.overview: Julio interviews Mariana and approves her hiring, to Bruna's fury. Ciro gets Gigio's report on the cafeterias. Nina and Duda look for Daniel.

videos.title: Chapter 45
videos.overview: Bruna complains to Mamma Vitória about Mariana's hiring.

videos.title: Chapter 46
videos.overview: Soró tells the family that Mamma Vitória wants to see Mariana, and Donana decides to go along. Ciro cancels dinner with Luísa because of Gigio, and she is disappointed.

videos.title: Chapter 47
videos.overview: Luísa cries over Ciro. Nina finds out how much money her mother has in her savings account and is disappointed. Guido fears that Giggo will take his place in the business.

videos.title: Chapter 48
videos.overview: Lála and Regina take a walk on the beach. Ciro tells Júlio that Bruna is jealous of him and Mariana. Donana thanks Mamma Vitória, leaving her moved.

videos.title: Chapter 49
videos.overview: Donana tells Mamma Vitória not to worry about Mariana. Franco hints to Duda that he is interested in her. Ciro and Luísa are surprised by Gigio's report.

videos.title: Chapter 50
videos.overview: Donana catches Gigio with Lála. Loreta takes issue with the closeness between Duda and Franco. Ciro goes out with Luísa to buy furniture for his living room. Bruna feels jealous of Mariana.

videos.title: Chapter 51
videos.overview: Bruna insults Mariana and badmouths her to Mamma Vitória. Luísa and Ciro arrive at Mamma Vitória's house and confront Bruna. Nizi and Altino cause another scene.

videos.title: Chapter 52
videos.overview: Ciro asks Mariana if there is anything going on between her and Júlio. Daniel pressures Nina to secure the sponsorship. Guido accuses Franco of being interested in Duda.

videos.title: Chapter 53
videos.overview: Nizi confesses her and Altino's plan to Julio and Luísa. Franco tells Nina that he likes Duda. Daniel encourages Gaspar to date Milica.

videos.title: Chapter 54
videos.overview: Giovanna tells Loreta that Franco is interested in Duda. Daniel is rude to Duda, and she is hurt. Bruna goes to the company to see Ciro's new office.

videos.title: Chapter 55
videos.overview: Bruna gives Júlio the cold shoulder, ignoring him when he tries to explain that he has no connection to Mariana. Bruna lays her cards on the table with Mariana, suggesting that she try to win Júlio over so that Bruna has a valid excuse to break off the engagement. Beth and Ciro are surprised when Bruna invites Mariana out for a walk and a shopping trip. Luísa warns Júlio that Bruna likely has ulterior motives behind the friendship she has just struck up with Mariana. Franco comforts Duda, who is crying because Daniel refused to study with her and treated her badly. Gema is concerned when she catches the two of them hugging in the bedroom. Júlio invites Mariana to dinner.

videos.title: Chapter 56
videos.overview: Persuaded by Júlio, Mariana finally accepts his dinner invitation. Gema mentions to Bruna that Duda ran away from home—with Mamma Vitória’s help—to come study with Franco. Loreta advises Joana to remarry after Joana admits she misses having a partner to share her joys and sorrows. Júlio surprises Luísa by saying he decided to go out with Marlene because she is a “beautiful and interesting” girl, not to make Bruna jealous. There is more to the story: Franco takes Duda back home, and Mamma Vitória shields them from Loreta’s scolding by asking to speak with them in private. Luísa tells Bruna that Júlio is going out to dinner with Mariana that night.

videos.title: Chapter 57
videos.overview: Pretending to be hurt by Júlio's behavior, Bruna plays the victim in front of her mother, by drawing her attention to the boy's interest in Mariana; Alone with Gema, however, Luísa tells her that it is Bruna who snubs Júlio, and that he has every right to choose another girlfriend. Bruna goes to Júlio's apartment, in his absence, and complains to Altino and Mizi that her fiance has been running away from her; After leaving, Altino tells Mizi that, in his opinion, Bruna lied to them. Mamma Vitória asks her daughter-in-law, and her grandchildren Benito and Duda not to bother Guido, because he has been very nervous, and could have a stroke or a heart attack. Donana blames Ciro for letting Mariana go out with Júlio, and demands that he bring her daughter back immediately.

videos.title: Chapter 58
videos.overview: Ciro tells Donana he won't go after Mariana and Júlio, as he has already done what he could by advising the young woman not to go out with him. Bruna goes to Ciro's house and makes things awkward for Donana while looking for her daughter, Mariana, who has gone out with Bruna's fiancé. Alone with Bruna, Ciro ends up hurting her feelings by saying that the only thing he feels for her is pity; Bruna then leaves, vowing to make him hate her one day. Upon returning home, Mariana is punished by Donana, who demands that she kneel and express remorse for having disobeyed her. Encouraged by his parents—who tell him that Bruna had come to the house looking to make amends—Júlio decides to go see her. The next day, at the company office, Júlio is taken aback when Bruna definitively breaks off their engagement and returns the ring.
